question: Thalassemia is a hereditary disease which affects
solution:
The correct answer is **__Blood__**.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thalassemia** is a **hereditary disease** that affects the blood.
 
• Thalassemia is a **blood disorder passed down through families i.e., Inherited.**
 
• It **makes the body in an abnormal form** or inadequate amount of hemoglobin.
 
• Hemoglobin is the **protein in Red Blood Cells** that carry oxygen.
 
• The disorder results in a** large number of Red Blood Cells** being destroyed, which leads to Anemia

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Different diseases:**

 
 
• **Lungs Diseases** - Asthma, Bronchitis, Pneumonia, Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
 
• **Heart Diseases **- Coronary Artery Disease, Heart Arrhythmias, Heart Failure, Heart Valve Disease, Pericardial Disease, Cardiomyopathy, Congenital Heart Disease.
